_note: Profile builder semantic tier (spec §9.1 step 3): descriptive phrases per factor, embedded together with the registry synonyms. A builder clause with no rule hit whose best cosine to a factor is ≥ the threshold (and is not negated) raises that factor to high. Phrases describe needs, not industries, so they do not pull towards a preset.
